basic_info.description: Incredibly remodeled alcove studio with stunning views to the West. Open customized kitchen with high end finishes and appliances.Bathroom has been completely redone with walk in shower and dual flush wall mounted toilet. Uniquely styled bedroom alcove with sliding glass panels allows privacy. Walk in closet includes a complete shelving system. Wood flooring throughout the unit. Lots of light and panoramic Western views through the large windows. Building is an Art Deco marvel featuring a soaring lobby with grand piano, ballroom/party room with adjacent community kitchen, 16th-floor sky deck, fitness center, laundry room and 24-hour manned desk. Convenient downtown location means no need for a car! HOA cost included heat, water, electric, trash.
